import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def binaryVectors : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n + 1 =>
      (binaryVectors n).map (fun xs => 0 :: xs) ++
      (binaryVectors n).map (fun xs => 1 :: xs)

def solutionLhs (matrix : List (List Nat)) (x : List Nat) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  ((List.range x.length).foldl
    (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0) % 2

def is_solution_bool (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length) &&
    (List.range matrix.length).all
      (fun i => decide (solutionLhs matrix x i = b.getD i 0))

def findSolutionAux
    (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) :
    List (List Nat) → Option (List Nat)
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs =>
      if is_solution_bool matrix b x then
        some x
      else
        findSolutionAux matrix b xs

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def solve_linear_system_gf2 (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Option (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  findSolutionAux matrix b (binaryVectors (matrix.getD 0 []).length)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (result : Option (List Nat)) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some x => is_solution matrix b x
  | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma is_solution_bool_eq_true_iff
    (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) :
    is_solution_bool matrix b x = true ↔ is_solution matrix b x := by
  simp [is_solution_bool, is_solution, solutionLhs, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range]

lemma mem_binaryVectors_iff (n : Nat) (xs : List Nat) :
    xs ∈ binaryVectors n ↔
      xs.length = n ∧ ∀ v, v ∈ xs → v = 0 ∨ v = 1 := by
  induction n generalizing xs with
  | zero =>
      cases xs <;> simp [binaryVectors]
  | succ n ih =>
      constructor
      · intro h
        simp [binaryVectors] at h
        rcases h with ⟨ys, hys, hEq⟩ | ⟨ys, hys, hEq⟩
        · subst xs
          have hy := (ih ys).mp hys
          constructor
          · simp [hy.1]
          · intro v hv
            simp at hv
            rcases hv with rfl | hv
            · exact Or.inl rfl
            · exact hy.2 v hv
        · subst xs
          have hy := (ih ys).mp hys
          constructor
          · simp [hy.1]
          · intro v hv
            simp at hv
            rcases hv with rfl | hv
            · exact Or.inr rfl
            · exact hy.2 v hv
      · intro h
        cases xs with
        | nil =>
            simp at h
        | cons a ys =>
            have htail_len : ys.length = n := by
              have hlen := h.1
              simp at hlen
              exact hlen
            have htail_bin : ∀ v, v ∈ ys → v = 0 ∨ v = 1 := by
              intro v hv
              exact h.2 v (by simp [hv])
            have hymem : ys ∈ binaryVectors n :=
              (ih ys).mpr ⟨htail_len, htail_bin⟩
            have ha : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := h.2 a (by simp)
            rcases ha with ha | ha
            · subst a
              simp [binaryVectors, hymem]
            · subst a
              simp [binaryVectors, hymem]

lemma findSolutionAux_some_is_solution
    (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat)
    (candidates : List (List Nat)) (x : List Nat) :
    findSolutionAux matrix b candidates = some x → is_solution matrix b x := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil =>
      simp [findSolutionAux]
  | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases h : is_solution_bool matrix b y = true
      · intro hfind
        simp [findSolutionAux, h] at hfind
        subst x
        exact (is_solution_bool_eq_true_iff matrix b y).mp h
      · intro hfind
        simp [findSolutionAux, h] at hfind
        exact ih hfind

lemma findSolutionAux_none_no_solution_mem
    (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat)
    (candidates : List (List Nat)) (x : List Nat) :
    findSolutionAux matrix b candidates = none →
    x ∈ candidates →
    ¬ is_solution matrix b x := by
  induction candidates with
  | nil =>
      intro _ hmem
      cases hmem
  | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases h : is_solution_bool matrix b y = true
      · intro hnone _
        have hcontr : some y = (none : Option (List Nat)) := by
          simpa [findSolutionAux, h] using hnone
        cases hcontr
      · intro hnone hmem
        simp [findSolutionAux, h] at hnone
        simp at hmem
        rcases hmem with hxy | hmem
        · subst x
          intro hsol
          exact h ((is_solution_bool_eq_true_iff matrix b y).mpr hsol)
        · exact ih hnone hmem

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond_satisfied (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) :
    solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond matrix b (solve_linear_system_gf2 matrix b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold solve_linear_system_gf2 solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond
  cases hres :
      findSolutionAux matrix b (binaryVectors (matrix.getD 0 []).length) with
  | none =>
      simp [hres]
      intro x hxlen hxbin
      exact
        findSolutionAux_none_no_solution_mem
          matrix b
          (binaryVectors (matrix.getD 0 []).length)
          x
          hres
          ((mem_binaryVectors_iff (matrix.getD 0 []).length x).mpr
            ⟨hxlen, hxbin⟩)
  | some x =>
      simpa [hres] using
        findSolutionAux_some_is_solution
          matrix b
          (binaryVectors (matrix.getD 0 []).length)
          x
          hres
  -- !benchmark @end proof
